summary.text: Kyndryl's platform for watching how enterprise AI agent fleets actually behave in production. summary.text: A multi-agent LangGraph platform that takes a plain-English policy like "All GCS buckets must have cost_center, environment and team labels" and turns it into compiled rules, live drift detection, risk-scored gcloud remediation plans, human-in-the-loop approvals, and audit-ready evidence — running against real GCP (Gemini 2.5 Pro on Vertex AI) or fully offline in mock mode for CI.

problem.text: Cloud governance policies are written in plain English but enforced by hand; drift goes unnoticed and remediation is unaudited.

approach.text: Policy Compiler: NL → structured PolicyConstraint via few-shot LLM. Rejects greetings, off-topic, or ambiguous policies.

approach.text: Drift Scanner: queries live GCS / Compute / IAM / SQL state; LLM compares to policy and emits structured violations.
approach.label: public

approach.text: Remediation Planner: generates ordered, reversible gcloud commands per violation, with rollback hints and blast-radius estimates.
approach.label: public

approach.text: Risk Assessor: guardrails first (BLOCKED / HIGH_RISK), then LLM rubric scoring 0–10. Auto-approve below 4.
approach.label: public

approach.text: Change Executor: runs approved commands via gcloud, re-queries the resource for post-state proof, refuses unapproved plans.
